svg.title: The Engram (Paper2Brain) corpus entity-graph flow through Cortexel
svg.desc: An Engram corpus-derivation receipt is budget-captured, digested with RFC 8785 SHA-256, and adapted through the receipt-bound branch, which verifies roster, ordering, endpoint membership, receipt equality and digest binding. The mapped graph passes the strict corpus.knowledge_graph gate with fail-closed provenance, then reaches the caption-bound DOM or 3D composition. Any mismatch fails closed with structured errors and no figure. Cortexel never authenticates the receipt or promotes its claims to paper-local evidence.
svg.text: Engram (Paper2Brain) corpus graph → caption-bound inspection figure
Receipt-bound branch: engram.corpus-derivation-receipt.v2. Evidence points into the verified snapshot — never invented, never promoted.
Engram corpus entity-graph response
nodes · edges · kinds · redundant counts · identity_derivation · derivation_receipt
honesty flags fixed conservative: advisory_only true · calibrated_posterior false
Budget-capture the raw value
snapshotValue(rawResponse, getBudgetLimits())
exact-JSON boundary: accessors rejected, budgets enforced before traversal
Digest the complete captured response
graphSnapshotId = canonicalDigest(captured.value) // RFC 8785 + SHA-256
the digest binds the raw response bytes — not a normalized clone
adaptEngramCorpusEntityGraph — receipt-bound checks
closed receipt identity · roster consistency (paths, binding id, strict order)
nodes unique + canonically ordered · edges unique, canonical, non-self, non-dangling
receipt == top-level identity_derivation · abstained ⇒ paper nodes + cites only
canonicalDigest(raw snapshot) === graphSnapshotId · final params revalidated
buildVizSpec — strict corpus.knowledge_graph gate
declaredInputs: graph_source · graph_snapshot_id · graph_scope · identity_advisory: true
fail-closed provenance baseline · bound honesty caption ("Advisory — …")
self-describing spec: skill + specVersion, safe to serialize and re-validate
Caption-bound inspection surfaces
KnowledgeGraphDomFigure — peer-free DOM: caption, legend, paginated operable
node list, complete source-record browser (≤ 1,000 nodes / 4,000 relationships)
KnowledgeGraphAccessibleFigure — canonical 3D composition (live force ≤ 250 / 1,000)
prepareCorpusKnowledgeGraphFigureJson — duplicate-safe raw-text boundary for hosts
Any mismatch fails closed
digest does not bind the response
receipt disagrees with the summary
roster ≠ paper-node roster
dangling or self edge
abstained derivation with entities
missing direct evidence anchor
naked or calibrated score
budgets exceeded
→ structured errors, no params,
no VizSpec, no figure, no caption.
What this flow does NOT establish
Cortexel creates presentation-local graph_snapshot_record references into the verified snapshot. It does not authenticate
Engram's upstream digest claims, resolve evidence, or convert the receipt into paper-local evidence.
Node and edge scores keep their declared discriminator (citation_resolution_confidence / structural_similarity) and are
never calibrated posteriors. All corpus-entity assertions remain advisory; identity edges and force geometry are not
certified quantitative evidence.
